description: A large collection of param rate and audio rate smoothing functions used all over evieve. Many are very efficient inexact destination smoothers, others are more expensive exact destination smoothers. There is enough variety here to suit all the situations evieve needs from a technical and also creative (sound design) point of view. This .genexpr file also inherits 'evi_utilities.genexpr' and 'evi_approx.genexpr', so it gets required in many evieve abstractions and is a very useful all-in-one require for a lot of what we need to do in gen~.
